name: Nonprofit Management
summary: Nonprofit Management prepares students to lead and operate nonprofit organizations such as charities, foundations, and community groups. Students learn fundraising, program management, and governance.
description: Nonprofit Management majors study the nonprofit sector, fundraising and development, grant writing, volunteer management, nonprofit finance and accounting, board governance, program planning and evaluation, marketing, and advocacy. Many programs are affiliated with national certification programs such as the Certified Nonprofit Professional credential. Students complete internships with nonprofit organizations and often work on projects for real community partners. Graduates work as program coordinators, development officers, and managers in human services, arts, education, health, and environmental nonprofits.
